description: Source code implementing a separate chaining hash map with functions for insertion, removal, rehashing, iteration, and conversion to list, using Zephyr OS data structures.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_sc_entry_init
methods.description: Initializes a hash map entry with a key and value, and initializes its node.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_sc_insert_entry
methods.description: Inserts an entry into the hash map based on its hash value.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_sc_insert_all
methods.description: Inserts all entries from a list into the hash map.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_sc_to_list
methods.description: Converts the hash map entries into a linked list.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_sc_rehash
methods.description: Rehashes the hash map, resizing buckets as needed.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_sc_find
methods.description: Finds an entry in the hash map by key.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_sc_iter_next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next entry.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_sc_iter
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for the hash map.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_sc_clear
methods.description: Clears the hash map, optionally calling a callback on each entry.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_sc_insert
methods.description: Inserts or updates an entry in the hash map.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_sc_remove
methods.description: Removes an entry from the hash map by key.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_sc_get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key in the hash map.
